<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>CEC Impeachment:</strong> The INDIA bloc is holding a &quot;public impeachment&quot; of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar today, escalating tensions ahead of their planned November 1 mega rally.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi-_?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I7</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I8</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I9</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Parliamentary Challenge:</strong> Union Home Minister Amit Shah has challenged opposition leaders Rahul Gandhi and Akhilesh Yadav to a special parliamentary session to debate allegations of &quot;vote theft&quot; and voter list irregularities.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I10</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I11</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Legislator Resignation:</strong> National Conference leader Aga Ruhullah is set to resign from his Lok Sabha seat on November 3.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I13</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Supreme Court Intervention:</strong> The Supreme Court has directed the Election Commission to address concerns regarding the bulk filing of Form 7 in Uttar Pradesh and to consider notices regarding voter deletions, while urging the extension of the Delhi voter-list process.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W17</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiogFBVV95cUxOYkRsbmVOaDQ1NVdyOUZWYURmMDd0S3JIYjhPUzc5TkZrNUF5NDRmRG8xbVVka2M4a0VINzN4VDNRcXpRbU13RmRyaHRaR2FOM3EydGYxMGZHUnZrUkpoT3RKS3JJSHVVQ3BhZG1RYUdidWd6VjBWZktYUmdiVnItT1pIRVlGUUItYmJwUVZ2TVcyc2paZkRJRGoteThYcmdpVFE?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W16</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Internal Party Dissent:</strong> A Haryana BJP MLA has publicly questioned the party&#x27;s merit-based jobs policy, warning that it could fuel anti-incumbency sentiment.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W11</a></span></li>
</ul>
